en.text: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿， 并恼恨一切真智慧。

zhTraditional.text: 與眾寡合的，獨自尋求心願， 並惱恨一切真智慧。

en.text: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人不喜爱明哲， 只喜爱显露心意。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人不喜愛明哲， 只喜愛顯露心意。

en.text: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人来，藐视随来； 羞耻到，辱骂同到。

zhTraditional.text: 惡人來，藐視隨來； 羞恥到，辱罵同到。

en.text: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

zhSimplified.text: 人口中的言语如同深水； 智慧的泉源好像涌流的河水。

zhTraditional.text: 人口中的言語如同深水； 智慧的泉源好像湧流的河水。

en.text: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

zhSimplified.text: 瞻徇恶人的情面， 偏断义人的案件，都为不善。

zhTraditional.text: 瞻徇惡人的情面， 偏斷義人的案件，都為不善。

en.text: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人张嘴启争端， 开口招鞭打。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人張嘴啟爭端， 開口招鞭打。

en.text: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

zhSimplified.text: 愚昧人的口自取败坏； 他的嘴是他生命的网罗。

zhTraditional.text: 愚昧人的口自取敗壞； 他的嘴是他生命的網羅。

en.text: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

zhSimplified.text: 传舌人的言语如同美食， 深入人的心腹。

zhTraditional.text: 傳舌人的言語如同美食， 深入人的心腹。

en.text: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

zhSimplified.text: 做工懈怠的， 与浪费人为弟兄。

zhTraditional.text: 做工懈怠的， 與浪費人為弟兄。

en.text: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的名是坚固台； 义人奔入便得安稳。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的名是堅固臺； 義人奔入便得安穩。

en.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

zhSimplified.text: 富足人的财物是他的坚城， 在他心想，犹如高墙。

zhTraditional.text: 富足人的財物是他的堅城， 在他心想，猶如高牆。

en.text: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

zhSimplified.text: 败坏之先，人心骄傲； 尊荣以前，必有谦卑。

zhTraditional.text: 敗壞之先，人心驕傲； 尊榮以前，必有謙卑。

en.text: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

zhSimplified.text: 未曾听完先回答的， 便是他的愚昧和羞辱。

zhTraditional.text: 未曾聽完先回答的， 便是他的愚昧和羞辱。

en.text: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

zhSimplified.text: 人有疾病，心能忍耐； 心灵忧伤，谁能承当呢？

zhTraditional.text: 人有疾病，心能忍耐； 心靈憂傷，誰能承當呢？

en.text: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

zhSimplified.text: 聪明人的心得知识； 智慧人的耳求知识。

zhTraditional.text: 聰明人的心得知識； 智慧人的耳求知識。

en.text: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

zhSimplified.text: 人的礼物为他开路， 引他到高位的人面前。

zhTraditional.text: 人的禮物為他開路， 引他到高位的人面前。

en.text: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

zhSimplified.text: 先诉情由的，似乎有理； 但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

zhTraditional.text: 先訴情由的，似乎有理； 但鄰舍來到，就察出實情。

en.text: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

zhSimplified.text: 掣签能止息争竞， 也能解散强胜的人。

zhTraditional.text: 掣籤能止息爭競， 也能解散強勝的人。

en.text: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄结怨，劝他和好，比取坚固城还难； 这样的争竞如同坚寨的门闩。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄結怨，勸他和好，比取堅固城還難； 這樣的爭競如同堅寨的門閂。

en.text: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

zhSimplified.text: 人口中所结的果子，必充满肚腹； 他嘴所出的，必使他饱足。

zhTraditional.text: 人口中所結的果子，必充滿肚腹； 他嘴所出的，必使他飽足。

en.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

zhSimplified.text: 生死在舌头的权下， 喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

zhTraditional.text: 生死在舌頭的權下， 喜愛它的，必吃它所結的果子。

en.text: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 得着贤妻的，是得着好处， 也是蒙了耶和华的恩惠。

zhTraditional.text: 得着賢妻的，是得着好處， 也是蒙了耶和華的恩惠。

en.text: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

zhSimplified.text: 贫穷人说哀求的话； 富足人用威吓的话回答。

zhTraditional.text: 貧窮人說哀求的話； 富足人用威嚇的話回答。

en.text: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

zhSimplified.text: 滥交朋友的，自取败坏； 但有一朋友比弟兄更亲密。

zhTraditional.text: 濫交朋友的，自取敗壞； 但有一朋友比弟兄更親密。
